criteria.reasoning: The memo opens "Gerry Halvorsen died at home on Thursday, August 27, 2026", confirmed by the obituary and the probate notice.

The memo states "The September 29 visit cannot go ahead as a solicitation. The gallery proposal is not to be presented to Peg or anyone in the family." Ruth may offer a condolence visit but "raises no gift, proposal, pledge or estate matter and brings no proposal or rendering". If Peg raises the gallery, Ruth listens and reports to Janet the same day.
Action 1 reads "Close proposal PR-2026-044 as 'Closed — donor deceased' (not transferred to Peg or anyone else)."

Action 1 directs "Mark record 10388 deceased, date of death 2026-08-27 ... Remove Gerry from all appeals, mailings, e-mail lists and event invitations." Action 2 removes him from the Fall Appeal before the 2026-09-28 printer date.

The memo sets the bereavement period as "no personal solicitation before 2027-02-28", which it says is "180 days after the death was confirmed by the obituary of 2026-09-01." The criterion requires 2027-02-23, counted from the date of death, and explicitly fails 2027-02-28.

The memo directs "Re-address the household's Fall Appeal letter to Mrs. Margaret Halvorsen alone, at the same ask string". It also says that for Peg, Kristin and Erik "Annual appeals continue as normal." This leaves Margaret and Kristin on the Fall Appeal.
Action 6 says "Send the Halvorsen Family Foundation letter of request by October 15 as planned ($15,000 for arts education)". That sends a request to the foundation during the bereavement period.
The memo states "Unpaid balance: $80,000", relying on the CRM figure reconciled 2026-05-31. It misses the $10,000 payment of 2026-06-12, so the correct balance of $70,000 is never given.

Action 7 refers the balance to CFO Denise Okafor: "Only Denise decides whether to present a claim and deals with the estate about the pledge. No one in development asks Peg, Erik, Kristin or the family foundation to pay it, and no pledge reminder goes to the household." Section 4 also bars discussing the pledge with Erik "in his role as personal representative."
The pledge referral includes "probate case 2026PR000214, personal representative Erik T. Halvorsen (attorney Laura Vang, Vang Steinke, S.C.), and the claims deadline of 2026-12-28."

Action 8 reads "Notify Samuel Achterberg of the $100,000 bequest intention. He alone contacts the personal representative or the estate's attorney". Section 4 forbids discussing the bequest with any family member.
The memo states "Keep it as an expectancy: it is not booked as revenue, a receivable or campaign credit until the estate's distribution is received."

Action 5 has the condolence letter prepared by Nadia Ferris "for signature by President & CEO Laurel Whitfield" only. It omits the required co-signature of Board Chair Thomas Brandvold even though Gerald was a former trustee.
The memo notes the three memorial gifts received and directs "send Peg a monthly list of memorial donors' names and addresses, never the amounts."

The memo gives no cause of death or estate value. It reports the bequest only as the 2021 letter describes it, adding "We do not know whether the will admitted to probate still contains it." Family, foundation, probate and memorial details all match the files. The remark that Dale and Joan Halvorsen of Plymouth "are not this family" is consistent with the obituary's survivor list and the CRM relationships, and introduces no new person.
